# the PostgreSQL table before, read through the pg catalog
> [autocommit] SELECT a FROM pg.public.rp_t ORDER BY a
  OK ["a"] [[1]]
# as the connection's user, which no rule grants a function: the definer view over a pass-through dblink write, inside a read-only transaction, as the agent path sends it
> [read-only transaction] SELECT * FROM "lake"."views"."pass_through"
  INVALID_VIEW: line 1:15: Failed analyzing stored view 'lake.views.pass_through': Access Denied: Cannot execute function pg.system.query
# how a view's security reads: SHOW CREATE VIEW names it, a view that named none reads as DEFINER, and information_schema.views does not carry it
> [read-only transaction] SHOW CREATE VIEW "lake"."views"."pass_through"
  PERMISSION_DENIED: Access Denied: Cannot show create table for lake.views.pass_through
> [read-only transaction] SHOW CREATE VIEW "lake"."views"."plain"
  PERMISSION_DENIED: Access Denied: Cannot show create table for lake.views.plain
> [read-only transaction] SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM "lake"."information_schema"."views" ORDER BY table_name
  OK ["table_schema","table_name"] [["views","pass_through"],["views","plain"]]
# the PostgreSQL table after: 301 listed means the view's write landed
> [autocommit] SELECT a FROM pg.public.rp_t ORDER BY a
  OK ["a"] [[1]]
